author: John Hammond
description:
Attackers are openly advertising phishing infrastructure with dashboards, token capture, and Office 365-focused services.

I walk through one of these marketplaces, examine the claims they're making, and discuss what defenders can learn from how these services are presented and marketed.

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/9b3kirR8s2U?si=QrZfZQ6l_h9UVQB6
title: Evil Token Marketplace
